nodes.name: FleetCard CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the FleetCard component displaying forklift/equipment summary in a clickable card grid. Covers card layout with a 4:3 image wrapper, status badges, body area (brand label, name with line-clamp, serial number, meta chips), an hour-meter progress bar with fill animation, a customer attribution row, and hover-revealed action buttons. Uses CSS custom properties throughout for theming.

nodes.name: ForkliftCard CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the ForkliftCard component showing a forklift summary card with lift-on-hover transform. Covers card layout with a 4:3 image wrapper, status badges, body section (brand label, model name, serial number with tabular numerals, meta items, hour meter text), and a hover-revealed edit button. Structurally very similar to FleetCard.css but uses a translateY hover effect instead of a box-shadow-only change. Uses CSS custom properties for theming.

nodes.name: PhotoGallery CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the PhotoGallery component used to display equipment photos. Covers the main 16:10 image view with left/right navigation arrows and a counter overlay, a hover-revealed fullscreen button, a thumbnail strip with active-state highlight, image caption, dashed empty-state panel, and a full-screen lightbox overlay (dark backdrop, large image, close button, arrow navigation, thumbnail row). Uses CSS custom properties and fixed z-index layering for the lightbox.

nodes.name: StatusTimeline CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the StatusTimeline component showing a vertical chronological history of equipment status changes. Covers timeline entry rows with a rail column (12px dot + 2px connecting line), content area (date label, bordered card with status badges, transition arrow, reason text in italics, user attribution), latest-entry dot variant highlighted in primary color, and a dashed empty-state panel. Uses CSS custom properties for colors and radii.
